meta.note: Reference formulas for retrieval only. Numeric design values are computed by the deterministic C# calculators and design-rules.json, never from this file. Blade angles are measured from the circumferential direction: backward below 90 degrees, radial 90 degrees, forward above 90 degrees.

sizing.name: Impeller outer diameter from static pressure coefficient
sizing.expression: U2 = sqrt(2 * Ps / (rho * psi_s)), D2 = 2 * U2 / omega

variables.psi_s: design static pressure coefficient of the blade type, dimensionless

sizing.name: Outlet blade width from flow coefficient
sizing.expression: cr2 = phi2 * U2, b2 = Q / (pi * D2 * cr2)

variables.cr2: radial velocity at the outlet, m/s
variables.phi2: design outlet flow coefficient of the blade type, dimensionless
variables.b2: axial blade width at the outlet, m

sizing.name: Impeller inlet diameter and inlet blade width

variables.D1/D2: inlet to outlet diameter ratio of the blade type, dimensionless
variables.b1: axial blade width at the inlet, m
variables.b1/b2: inlet to outlet width ratio of the blade type, dimensionless

velocity_triangles.name: Inlet flow angle (reference check)
velocity_triangles.expression: cr1 = Q / (pi * D1 * b1), U1 = omega * D1 / 2, beta1_flow = atan(cr1 / U1)

variables.cr1: radial velocity at the inlet, m/s
variables.beta1_flow: relative flow angle at the inlet from the circumferential direction, deg

variables.beta2_nominal: nominal blade outlet angle of the blade type, deg

slip_and_euler.name: Total pressure rise
slip_and_euler.expression: Pt = Ps + 0.5 * rho * Vout^2, Vout = k_out * U2

variables.k_out: outlet velocity to tip speed ratio, dimensionless

slip_and_euler.name: Euler pressure rise
slip_and_euler.expression: dp_euler = rho * U2 * Cu2, Cu2 = Pt / (rho * eta_h * U2)

variables.dp_euler: ideal pressure rise from the Euler equation, Pa
variables.Cu2: tangential velocity component at the outlet, m/s
variables.eta_h: assumed hydraulic efficiency of the blade type, dimensionless

slip_and_euler.name: Blade outlet angle from the outlet velocity triangle

variables.beta2: blade outlet angle from the circumferential direction, deg
variables.cr2: radial velocity at the outlet, m/s
variables.Cu2: tangential velocity component at the outlet, m/s

variables.t_blade: blade thickness (maximum thickness for airfoil blades), m
variables.fraction: blade thickness fraction of D2 for the blade type, dimensionless

variables.t_plate: impeller back plate and shroud thickness, m
variables.fraction: plate thickness fraction of D2, dimensionless

variables.D_hub: hub or shaft boss diameter, m
variables.k_hub: hub to inlet diameter ratio, dimensionless

impeller_geometry.name: Blade centerline
impeller_geometry.expression: beta(r) = beta1 + (beta2 - beta1) * (r - r1) / (r2 - r1), d(theta)/dr = 1 / (r * tan(beta(r)))

variables.beta(r): local blade angle from the circumferential direction, deg
variables.theta: wrap angle of the blade centerline, rad

casing_geometry.name: Casing base circle
casing_geometry.expression: c = max(fraction * D2, c_min), D3 = D2 + 2 * c

variables.c: radial gap between impeller and scroll base circle (cutoff clearance), m
variables.fraction: cutoff clearance fraction of D2, dimensionless

variables.W: internal axial width of the scroll, m
variables.k_w: casing width to blade width ratio, dimensionless

variables.t_wall: casing wall and side plate thickness, m
variables.fraction: casing wall thickness fraction of D3, dimensionless

variables.h_out: radial height of the discharge opening, m
variables.W: internal axial width of the scroll, m

variables.D_inlet: inlet opening diameter in the casing side plate, m
variables.k_in: casing inlet to impeller inlet diameter ratio, dimensionless

variables.r_s(phi): scroll inner radius at angle phi from the cutoff, m
variables.phi: angle from the cutoff measured in the direction of rotation, rad
variables.h_out: radial height of the discharge opening, m
